title: malveopsis calycina
intro: Malveopsis calycina, commonly known as the dwarf mallow, is a type of flowering plant belonging to the Malvaceae family. The dwarf mallow has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can aid in reducing symptoms of conditions such as arthritis and promoting overall well-being. The therapeutic actions of Malveopsis calycina include its ability to act as an anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant agent, making it a potential treatment for wounds and skin conditions. The bioactive constituents of the dwarf mallow include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
